summary: BMO 2024-5C5 Mortgage Trust filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) referencing the existing pooling and servicing agreement for the trust. The filing notes that the mortgage loan secured by iPark Norwalk, an asset of the issuing entity, is being serviced under a separate PSA (BANK5 2024-5YR8). No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change—is announced. This is a routine current report about servicing arrangements for an asset-backed securities trust.
